nodes.label: Six exit rules across six stocks
nodes.rationale: Runs thirty-six alternative $1,000 accounts over nine dates. Only FTFT trades, so adding SES, TE, GRAB, RR and SERV does not expand executed opportunities. All six exits profit on the same previously exposed FTFT entry.

nodes.label: FTFT SES TE GRAB RR SERV alternative-account cohort
nodes.rationale: Each symbol/rule combination has continuous settled cash and one filled episode per day. The other five stocks submit no orders; 48 of their 88 alerts have empty price intervals. Exit changes cannot repair entry feasibility, and original >=1.5 reward/risk admission does not promise the modified exits' payoff.

nodes.label: Coverage-based universe selection amendment
nodes.rationale: A retrospective assets screen yielded 1,024 candidates, 164 daily-filter passes and twelve minute preflights. Full pre-period coverage selected only GRAB, so the preserved failed criterion was amended before test acquisition to require 21 consecutive opening minutes and rank coverage and liquidity. GRAB, SERV and RR were selected; the six-stock panel still has 934 missing regular-session minute slots.

nodes.label: Outcome-selected exit rules and dependent comparisons
nodes.rationale: The six candidates were selected because they previously profited on FTFT, while stock membership remains retrospective. Nominal cells and six FTFT repeats reuse observations; 84 tests and 97 audit groups verify implementation but do not supply independent trading evidence or new-stock stress robustness.
